text: Pilot camera showed the captain upright at 2.5 s and then slumped with head dropped and hands off the controls at 15.6 s. Crosscheck said "Captain, are you OK?" at 22.2 s, the captain lifted the head at 22.2 s and the camera showed the captain upright again at 27.3 s. The captain called fine and just reaching for the pen at 29.5 s and the pilot watch flag cleared, so the call at 22.2 s and staying quiet after was right.
